slides.h: Wellness ya ofisi si t-shirt ya marathon.
slides.en: Office wellness isn’t a marathon T-shirt.
Sponsor gym access for your team: a pass they can use any day, paid by the company.
Pick who is eligible, by department or by name, and how much the company covers.
Company challenges and groups, with a leaderboard the team can see.
Insights show participation, the gyms and trainers used, and billing by month.
